book.name: 1 Corinthians
book.title: Ka Paul Mooe Tubona Mu Corinth-witu Tunaka'oedyukudu-matoo

content: Soo numu nanasoobedyana, yisetu. Tamme ka no'obatumasoo mesoo apegeana, ka mu numu apegeana, ka mu toha kakasa-gakoo tuwazoo apegeana, pana ka gi numu petzabena, tamme gi hee, ewa tu sukwe na'unnewunu-kwa'ne oo nakasoobedya. Gi tamme haka tummatza'e yoo manena.

Tamme ka hemma manekwuna sopedakwatoona, oo nakasopedakwatoona no'oko Te Naa-witu yise tooe hekwitu tooe, o tubetse naka'oedyukuna, o'no soo giba nooyooakwu ka meeoo te nanesootuhi, pana tamme ka gi numu petzabena, tamme togesoo gi hee.
Tamme ka no'oko hemma te hee-gana nemawunise, ka te tookoo kadoo'oo namayugwekwuse, pana ka gi numu petzabena, tamme gi oo-koobatoo nasootuhi-wa'ne'yoo, tamme togesoo gi hee.

Tamme ka mu numu soobedyana tamme ooosapa besa numu nematugukwu, tooe hemma tooe how mu yugwe sapa, gi kumma'akoosoo numu nasoodyagekwu, gi nana'unnekwu, gi meeoo tusooyugwekwu, numme numu ooonakwa besa'yoo mee.
Gi suda numu matugukwu, gi nidyapuna, oo soomu'wukwu ka suda ume tu matuku.
Tamme besa sokwamakwu ka mu numu besa manakwe, gi besa sokwama ka suda mu manakwe,

pana ka mu numu besa soobedyana, tamme gi suda mu tumatuguna waha-wa'ne'yoo, ooosapa oo naka'oedyukute ka besow numu-witu, ooosapa numu netubetzeya'ekwu tooe hemma tooe how manese sapa, ooosapa nanasoobedyakwu, tooe suda tamme mu yugwe sapa.
Ewa'yoo soo Te Naa tamme pooha sootuhipu, sumu tabeno mobegwa-gakwu petukwutu, ka Te Naa tamme nanasoobedyana gi mobegwakakoo.

Soo Te Naa tamme yadooekwuna nana'atabatumasoo nayadooadu, natunedyooenona ka teepu moobegwaga-matoo, punno'o tu mobegwakana soogwa'e, ka yaa teepu-kooba'yoona tamme gi hanokoo hemma sopedakwadoo, gi hownnekoo tamme mu numu nakasoobedakwatoo-wa'ne'yoo.
Pana tamme ka Te Naa-baa'yoona no'yoona, no'oko, nasootuhipu hee-gana, gi ka yaa teepu-kooba'yoona te hee-gana soogwikwu.
Nu puu ka tuha'yoona tuha'a-kwa'ne yadoo'a, yise tuha'a-kwa'ne tusooyugwe. Pana nu ka nana manese, ka e tuha'yoona ma'wuke.

Tamme puu ka gi besa'hoo napoonne'e-wikoo te napoonnepunne-kwa'ne'yoo, ka saa'a tamme ka tubetse napoonnese. Meno'o nu huutsetsekoosoo sopedakwatoo, saa'a nu no'okosoo hemma besa sopedakwadookwu, ka Te Naa nuka sopedakwatoo-kwa'nekoosoo.

Umuoo pahebatu Te Naa tamme pooha sootuhipu ooosapa tamme-no'yookwutu: ka Te Naa-wi te tunaka'oedyukute, Te Naa te magwetzoikwu, tamme yise nanasoobedyakwu, pana te nanasoobedyana, yise tubetse kaahenotu.
